title: Fix the battery percentage stuck at 99%
prompt: The battery percentage on the Kestrel 6 stays at 99% after a full charge and never reaches 100%. Find out why in resonant-fw, fix it with a test, and open a pull request.

payload.text: The battery percentage on the Kestrel 6 stays at 99% after a full charge and never reaches 100%. Find out why in resonant-fw, fix it with a test, and open a pull request.
A value stuck one short of full usually means a clamp, or a full-charge signal that never arrives. Start where the percentage is computed, then look at how the charger reports a finished charge.
I'll start by finding where the battery percentage is computed.
The percentage is held at 99 until `charge_complete` is set. So the real question is why the charger never reports a finished charge. Let me look at where that flag is written.

Found it. The charge counts as finished only when the current drops below 20 mA, but the charger IC on this board terminates at 60 mA (its datasheet's default ITERM). The current never goes under 20 mA, so `charge_complete` stays false and the display is clamped at 99%. I'll make the threshold match the charger and add a test.

items.content: Match the end-of-charge threshold to the charger's termination current
Add a test for the full-charge path
